title: Seed Workshop
alt: A circuit-patterned creature and a round-eared peace-sign character stand beside a low potting bench holding sprouts, a veined seed, acorns, and a vase with a circular opening.
description: Two unlikely gardeners gather sprouts, seeds, and acorns around a little potting bench.

title: Leaf Regatta
alt: A creature with three tall sails rides a pointed leaf through pale blue water, while a broad grinning frog watches from a rock and a long-finned fish swims below.
description: A three-sailed leaf rider drifts past a grinning frog and a darting fish.

title: Sunflower Encounter
alt: A dapper cat and an upright wolf with a sunflower on its tail meet beside a smiling sunflower, with a small spiky-backed dog and oak sprigs in the foreground.
description: A sunflower-tailed wolf meets a dapper cat beneath an even larger smiling flower.

title: Pebble Parade
alt: Four unusual pencil figures, including a robed long-snouted character and a small flame-headed person, line up behind a curving row of pebbles and pointed leaves.
description: Four differently shaped notebook characters gather along a playful trail of pebbles.

title: Canopy Explorers
alt: A towering woodgrain bird crowned by a tree overlooks a staff-carrying bird, a parrot greeting a spiral snail, and a shaggy sloth in a clearing edged with leaves and small flowers.
description: A bird crowned with a tree becomes a landmark for a small gathering of explorers.

title: Wayside Market
alt: A leaf-crowned round vendor and a flame-headed shield character meet at a small wooden roadside stall displaying grapes and a cluster of eye-berries.
description: A handful of fruit, weathered boards, and two odd customers become a tiny wayside market.

title: Rain Beneath the Bell
alt: A striped spiral-eyed worm and a root-footed four-leaf figure take shelter beneath a hanging bell flower while fine pencil rain falls around scattered leaves.
description: A hanging flower becomes a shelter for two small notebook creatures.

title: Tidepool Conversation
alt: A sleepy tongue-out fish and a whiskered serpent share a shallow pencil tidepool bordered by ring-patterned stones and wavy ribbon leaves.
description: Two unlikely water creatures share a pool edged with familiar stones and leaves.

title: Courtyard Balancing Act
alt: A bearded wizard balances on his long board in a lightly sketched courtyard while an angular wide-eyed antenna bug watches beside a candle and an oak medallion.
description: The board-riding wizard finds a small audience in a quiet courtyard.

title: Field-Edge Windbreak
alt: A long-necked crested bird shelters beside an ink evergreen while two different notebook birds cross above a sparse field of rooted seed plants.
description: Three distinctly drawn birds meet along a sparse field windbreak.

title: Greenhouse Gossip
alt: Pencil doodles of a beak-shaped plant, split seed bloom, and crowned heart cactus sharing a spare greenhouse.
description: An airy greenhouse brings together five plant doodles with only a few penciled panes and benches.

title: Windblown Shore
alt: A shaggy long-legged bird and a tongue-tipped eye feather cross pale coastal dunes amid windblown leaves.
description: An unusual bird and an eye feather share a breezy coast, with source leaves and flowing marks carrying the wind.

title: Beneath the Roots
alt: A wide-mouthed antenna creature and striped worm meet beneath fine garden roots beside a seedling in an oval.
description: A light garden cutaway assembles a strange creature, striped worm, seedling, leaves and pebbles without filling the soil.

title: Acorn Orchard
alt: An acorn-eyed leaf walker and an instrument-shaped creature visit a small orchard of cloud-canopy trees and fallen acorns.
description: A leaf walker and ornamental companion explore widely spaced trees, using acorns, oak leaves and a leaf medallion as ground details.

title: Daisy Path
alt: A leafy bird in striped legs and a sleepy-eyed frog pause on a winding meadow path lined with tiny daisies and clover.
description: Two original character drawings meet along a simple meadow path, with daisies, clover and one fallen angular leaf.

title: Birdsong Assembly
alt: A raven, long-tailed flycatcher, red-eyed vireo, and common flicker occupy lightly drawn branches above tiny firs and a few oak leaves.
description: Four very different birds find their own perches in a quiet stand of trees.

title: Cabinet of Small Wonders
alt: A toothed round vessel, little portal on a pedestal, haloed creature in a vase, leaf-shaped dagger, and two-leaf sprout sit on lightly sketched shelves.
description: Odd vessels and a tiny portal share a shelf with a sprout and a leaf-shaped tool.

title: Reedbed Lookout
alt: A hook-beaked feathered bird and Carolina wren watch an antenna creature at the edge of a sparse reedbed, surrounded by feather-shaped and lobed leaves.
description: Two birds discover a small antenna creature among the reeds.

title: The Balancing Path
alt: A striped balancing animal stands on one leg beside a big-mouthed eyestalk creature and a bow-tied bird person, with oak-leaf puddles and a winding pencil path.
description: A striped acrobat holds a pose while two curious onlookers pause along the path.

title: Crombot’s Garden Visit
alt: A small robot car with sensor eyes and looping wires meets a bow-tied crocodile at a lightly drawn garden gate framed by vines and little sprouts.
description: Crombot rolls up to a garden gate, where a bow-tied crocodile is waiting.
